Rajasthan Panchayat Elections: Reservation Lottery Determines Seats for Women

In Rajasthan, a reservation lottery has been conducted for upcoming Panchayat elections. Following the lottery, the equations for leadership have changed, with women set to take charge of 26 Gram Panchayats in Chittorgarh. Across the state, 7200 women are expected to become Sarpanches, with the lottery also determining seat allocations for various social categories.
